new_problems: Run L4a's 'one-wait rule' and L4a-left-1 interact: with no session kept, POST /sessions on a refused credential still starts a session that meets the refusal and ends to wait. This keeps the refused-key case's 'starts both by itself' from real-daemon.test.ts line ~8508. The dialog never offers that Start, but the API and phone can. Owner question: should a start under a refused credential be refused in words outright?

The status-line sentence the spec suggested for L4-creds-26 ('Ready: 2 tasks; your subscription is at its limit until 02:51. Start asks about your API key.') is 93 characters, past design §5's 80. I built 'Ready: N tasks; your subscription is at its limit until HH:MM; Start asks first', falling back to 'Ready: N tasks; Start asks about your API key until HH:MM' when longer.

The Start dialog plan sentence and the Use API key figure come from different sums: on the bench, two tasks at about CHF 0.06 each, and Use API key 'about CHF 0.11'. They are consistent but rounded separately, so a person may read 0.06 + 0.06 beside 0.11.
Pre-existing lint warnings remain (StartSessionDialog.tsx:244 noUselessFragments from 170859f4; capabilities tests noNonNullAssertion). They are not from this area.
notes_for_other_areas: start-check.ts: inFlightWork(deps, projectId) and waitingWorkUsdMicro(check, inFlight) give the one figure for the waiting work (review parts included, capped at the work budget). Use them wherever a screen prices waiting work.
grant-readmit.ts: waitedForCredential(store, projectId) lists the ready tasks that waited for a credential (CREDENTIAL_WAIT_REASON). onGrant readmits only those.

WaitEntry.needs (billing-pick) and executor's billing.noteNeeds?(sourceId, projectId, needs) persist why a task waits for one credential. credential-wait.ts: needsWaitWords(kind, needs) returns {label, line, why}, and canDoWords is exported.
waits.now(projectId) can now return askFirst (the stop in a few words) under 'ask'. projectStatusLine reads it. startBlocked's credentialWait takes startsAt (a kept person Start).
waitThenStartSentence(wait, {on: 'plan'|'new_task', ask}). The chooser's forTask/batch input takes `on`, and the plan card passes on:'plan'.

POST /sessions: refusals in words carry details.reason 'start_refused' and answer 400 'validation' (was 409 'conflict'); the fake daemon matches. The refused credential is checked first only while a session is kept.
StartsWait 'queued' has goesOn (a continuation behind another project's session: 'Goes on after the session on "X"').
CANCEL_WAIT_EXPLAIN now reads 'Cancel: nothing starts when Claude is back; its tasks wait for your Start.'
ChatRequestBody.heldTurn (with oneOff) and ChatRequest.heldTurn: the answer replaces the held turn (chat.human 'replaces'). readTranscript leaves replaced turns out of the view and the history.

apps/ui lib/time.ts: setPersonZone(zone) / personTimeZone(). Every time helper takes an optional zone and writes in the person's zone by default; the store's 'me' action and the phone's store set it. UI tests that build times must use the person's zone (the fixture's person is Europe/Zurich).
Owner question default kept: ONE_OFF_UNDER_WAIT = true (Use API key is offered under 'then wait' too).
